name: Konrad von Feuchtwangen
note: source gives reign to 1297 but death 4 July 1296; work list says from 1291; moved HQ to Venice after fall of Acre

name: Albert of Brandenburg-Ansbach
note: last Hochmeister; converted to Lutheranism and turned the State of the Teutonic Order into the secular Duchy of Prussia in 1525; state ends
